{{Quote|Perhaps I'll occupy the ninety-nine percent of my cognitive module ''not'' engaged by my chores by solving Chun's Theory of Reductional Infinity.|Protocol droid I-5YQ|<ref name="MedStar I">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>}}
'''Chun's Theory of Reductional Infinity''' was a theory formulated by an individual named [[Chun]].<ref name="MedStar I" /> By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'' to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> the theory had yet to be solved.<ref name="MedStar I" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="TERC" /> the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[I-5YQ]]&mdash;while not occupied with his work at the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]&mdash;thought about using his free [[Droid brain/Legends|cognitive module]] in solving the theory.<ref name="MedStar I" />

==Behind the scenes==
The theory was first mentioned in ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', the first novel of the [[MedStar Duology]]. The book was written by [[Steve Perry]] and [[Michael Reaves]] and published in [[2004]].<ref name="MedStar I" /> Mention of Chun's Theory was not included in the [[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons (abridged audiobook)|''MedStar I: Battle Surgeons'' abridged audiobook]] that released alongside the novel.<ref name="Abridged audiobook">[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons (abridged audiobook)|''MedStar I: Battle Surgeons'' abridged audiobook]]</ref>
